'''Broken Glasses''' are a type of [[trash]] that can be caught when fishing during all seasons, in any location, using either a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] or a [[Crab Pot]]. They can also be found in [[Garbage Can]]s, and any crab pot fish may produce Broken Glasses when placed in a [[Fish Pond]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

Broken Glasses can be [[Recycling Machine|recycled]] into [[Refined Quartz]].

==Bundles==
Broken Glasses are not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Broken Glasses are not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Broken Glasses can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Trash Can Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt232.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
During the special order quest [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Community Cleanup]] the player is tasked with gathering 20 trash items (except Joja Cola).

==Trading==
Once unlocked, the Raccoon's wife near the [[Giant Stump]] will trade for Broken Glasses.
